text:
Hannah: Putting together the release notes for next Wednesday's docs deploy. Blocks: embedding example in migration guide failing CI, a renamed JS client API, and a couple of stale internal anchors. Need owners for snippet update, redirect, and the final copy.

Lukas: I can take the snippet. Integration tests show `jsClient.embed('x')` -> 400/422 depending on payload. Recommend switching docs to `client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'x' })`. I'll prepare JS + Python minimal examples.

Priya: I'll handle redirects and internal link updates. CI LinkCheck flagged guides/migration/embedding.md#legacy-anchor which should point to migration/embedding-v3.md#legacy-embeddings. I'll add a redirect entry and update the link text.

infra-bot: NOTE: redirects merged after 07:45 UTC will be picked up in the next deploy cycle. Plan merges accordingly.

Hannah: Draft relnotes copy proposal: "Embeddings: SDK request shape changed. Update code to use client.embeddings.create() — see the Embeddings migration guide for examples and a one-line diff. Known issue: pre-0.9 SDKs may return 4xx on old embed methods." Keep it short?

Lukas: Short is good. For the migration guide I'll include a tiny diff showing old -> new and a succinct reason: request envelope changed to {model, input}.

Priya: Redirect PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2207. Added mapping from the old anchor to migration/embedding-v3.md#legacy-embeddings and updated links in the guide. Tagged infra for fast review.

Lukas: Snippet PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2208. Includes JS + Python final examples and a one-line diff in the migration guide. Also added a short changelog bullet under "Examples".

docs-bot: Link Scanner: 3 anchors scanned, 1 previously broken anchor now updated in PR #2207.

Hannah: Great. Quick checklist before I publish relnotes:
- Lukas: confirm snippet PR includes the final example only in relnotes and full diff in migration guide (assigned)
- Priya: get redirect merged and confirm deploy timing with infra (assigned)
- Hannah: I'll post the relnotes draft in #docs for signoff once PRs are merged.

Lukas: Confirmed. I kept the relnotes example minimal per our style guide.

Priya: Infra reviewed the redirect PR and approved; merging after CI passes. They noted the window at 07:45 UTC for inclusion.

Hannah: I'll hold the relnotes publish until both PRs are merged. If anyone spots other stale anchors run `make linkcheck` locally or ping docs-bot to run a full scan. Thanks! :thumbsup:
